label: Meta Audience Network
terms_note: Meta developer app + Audience Network property; Graph API reporting endpoint; free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Meta app; publisher Reporting API on the Graph API)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** for our purpose — publisher reporting via the Graph API; buying happens in Meta Ads (meta client) Confidence: **medium**.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: Long-lived Meta User Access Token with the read_audience_network_insights permission (system user tokens are not supported by this endpoint); long-lived user tokens last about 60 days and must then be renewed.

me.note: GET /me: the user the token belongs to ({id, name}).

get_report.note: GET /{account_id}/adnetworkanalytics (account_id = the Business, property or app id) with metrics fb_ad_network_request, _imp, _click, _revenue, aggregation_period=day, since/until: one row per metric per day (value is a string; revenue in the account currency). Synchronous queries cover at most 8 days and 2,000 rows; data is kept 540 days. Audience Network is a publisher (monetisation) product; `campaign_id` does not apply.

not_offered.list_accounts: The Audience Network Reporting API is queried per Business, property or app id ("GET /<ID>/adnetworkanalytics", https://developers.facebook.com/docs/audience-network/optimization/report-api/guide-v2); it has no account listing, so pass that id as account_id.
not_offered.list_campaigns: Audience Network is a publisher monetisation product; its Reporting API reports requests, impressions, clicks and revenue and has no advertiser campaigns (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/audience-network/optimization/report-api/guide-v2).
not_offered.update_budget: No campaigns or budgets exist on the publisher side of Audience Network (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/audience-network/optimization/report-api/guide-v2).
not_offered.pause_resume: No campaigns exist on the publisher side of Audience Network (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/audience-network/optimization/report-api/guide-v2).
